Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as rising oil, Treasury yields lift Fed hike bets
Markets.summary: U.S. stocks fell as rising oil prices and Treasury yields increased expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike next week. Nvidia and Micron declined, while Apple gained following the launch of its new iPhone.

Markets.title: US bond yields climb to multi-year highs as oil surge revives bets on higher Fed rates
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields climbed to multi-year highs, with the 10-year yield approaching 5%. This increase was driven by rising oil prices, growing government debt supply, and renewed expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes.

Markets.title: Oil surges 5%, Brent and US crude both over $100 on more tanker attacks
Markets.summary: Oil prices jumped 5% above $100 a barrel as escalating US-Iran conflict and tanker attacks raised supply disruption fears. This upward pressure was further intensified by rising Chinese demand and tighter OPEC output.

Markets.title: Hotter producer prices strengthen bets on a Fed rate hike
Markets.summary: Higher-than-expected US producer prices have increased market expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates by a quarter-point next week. Additionally, rising oil prices from the renewed Middle East conflict are further complicating the inflation outlook.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets ended higher after reversing losses during the closing auction, snapping a three-session decline. Meanwhile, cautious sentiment persisted due to crude oil prices remaining above $102, weak global cues, and rising yields.

Markets.title: Will Bitcoin touch $400,000 by 2030? Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong answers
Markets.summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong predicts Bitcoin could reach $400,000 by 2030, maintaining that this target is still reasonable. He believes the cryptocurrency has passed its market bottom, with upcoming halving events and regulatory updates expected to drive future growth.

Geo-Political.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
Geo-Political.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels have reportedly seized the strategic Red Sea port of Mokha. This capture brings the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait, which is a key shipping route.

Geo-Political.title: Can Trump really pay $5,000 to every American adult?
Geo-Political.summary: Analysts are questioning the legality, affordability, and overall feasibility of Donald Trump's election-year proposal to pay $5,000 to every American adult. Experts remain doubtful that the U.S. president's financial offer is actually workable.

Geo-Political.title: Pilot warned Amazon cargo plane going too fast before deadly crash, data shows
Geo-Political.summary: Flight data from a deadly Amazon cargo plane crash reveals that one pilot warned the other about excessive speed as alarms sounded. The warning received an uneven response from the receiving pilot moments before the fatal impact.

Geo-Political.title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is suing a newspaper over a report claiming the UAE warned him about the 7 October attack. The newspaper stated it stands by its reporting, which was based on extracts from a new book.

Geo-Political.title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
Geo-Political.summary: Over 20 children died in a stampede while fleeing a fire that engulfed two schools in Bukavu, a rebel-held city in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Officials confirmed the casualties resulted from the panic as students tried to escape the flames.

Geo-Political.title: Man jailed after threatening to kill son's teacher in French village
Geo-Political.summary: A court jailed a father for threatening to behead a female primary school teacher. The incident occurred near Toulouse in a French village.

Data & Insights.summary: A potential US-Iran war threatens energy supplies, trade, and the diaspora, making West Asia crucial for India. A prolonged disruption could increase India's import costs, raise inflation, and negatively impact its economy.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: How it started, expanded and grew into an 11-nation bloc with 40% of global GDP
Data & Insights.summary: India is hosting the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi on September 12–13, marking 20 years since the bloc's founding. The group has now expanded to 11 member nations that collectively account for 40% of global GDP.

Data & Insights.title: Diplomacy tightrope, economic heft test await India at Brics summit
Data & Insights.summary: At the upcoming BRICS summit, India aims to advance cooperation on trade, payments, energy security, and supply chains. Simultaneously, New Delhi must delicately manage its diplomatic relations with China, Russia, and the broader Global South.

Data & Insights.title: Goyal bats for common Brics trade platform, women-focused fund
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal advocated for a common BRICS trade platform and a women-focused fund during his address. He spoke at the BRICS Women’s Business Alliance Women-Led Development Conference ahead of the group's summit in New Delhi.

Data & Insights.title: India-Thailand trade talks focus on market access, Asean trade agreement review
Data & Insights.summary: India and Thailand agreed to accelerate the review of their Asean trade agreement to address India's expanding trade deficit, which reached $10.81 billion in 2025. Both countries also pledged to strengthen business-to-business connections to promote balanced economic growth.

India.title: Delhi Building Collapse: Satya Niketan PG Operator Denied Anticipatory Bail
India.summary: A Delhi court denied anticipatory bail to a paying guest (PG) accommodation operator named Tyagi following a building collapse in Satya Niketan. The judge based the decision on evidence against Tyagi, which included a statement from an injured student.

India.title: CCTV Trail Deepens Odisha Orangutan Mystery, Probe Stretches To Sea Routes
India.summary: Two young orangutans are currently being cared for at a Bhubaneswar zoo while an investigation tracks their transport route using CCTV footage. Police are expanding their probe to include sea routes to solve the mystery of how the animals entered India.

India.summary: Aqib Bashir, a drug smuggler who escaped from Narcotics Control Bureau custody in Jammu, changed his appearance to avoid capture. He was recaptured in Jalandhar, Punjab, through a joint operation by the NCB, Jammu and Kashmir Police, and Punjab Police.
